channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Once a national obsession, traditional Korean wrestling fights for survival
item.description: SEOUL: As South Korea’s global cultural influence expands in areas such as music, film and television, one form of entertainment struggling to attract attention even at home is Korea’s traditional style of wrestling, known as ssireum.

item.title: PN open to new parties as Hamzah weighs political options
item.description: KOTA BARU: Perikatan Nasional (PN) has no objection to new parties joining the coalition, including one that may be led by former Bersatu deputy president Datuk Seri Hamzah Zainudin.

item.title: Danaher closes in on nearly US$10bil deal for Masimo
item.description: WASHINGTON: Life sciences firm Danaher is closing in on a nearly US$10 billion deal to acquire pulse oximeter maker Masimo, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing sources.

item.title: France axes Crinon from Olympics after ice hockey fight
item.description: MILAN: France’s Pierre Crinon will take no further part in the men’s Olympic ice hockey tournament, the French Ice Hockey Federation (FFHG) said on Monday, after the defender earned a game misconduct in their final group game with Canada for fighting.

item.title: Japan's debt issuance to surge 28pct in fiscal 2029 from 2026
item.description: TOKYO: Japan will likely see annual bond issuance surge 28 per cent three years from now on rising debt-financing costs, a finance ministry estimate reviewed by Reuters showed on Tuesday, casting doubt on premier Sanae Takaichi’s argument the country can deliver tax cuts without boosting debt.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Bad audio at Bukit Jalil: Ella's concert organisers lodge police report
item.description: ​KUALA LUMPUR: The organisers behind the Majlis Tertinggi Rock Queen Ella 2026 concert, held at the Bukit Jalil National Stadium (SNBJ) last Saturday, have lodged a police report following technical glitches that marred the audio experience for fans on the third floor.

item.title: Kuantan murder-suicide: Close-knit neighbourhood horrified by killings
item.description: KUANTAN: A quiet residential neighbourhood here was rocked by tragedy this morning when a family of five was found dead inside their home in what police believe to be a murder-suicide case.

item.title: Kuching City eye Sarawak's first Malaysia Cup final in 27 years
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The pressure heading into the Malaysia Cup semi-finals may not necessarily rest on newcomers Kuching City when they face 33-time champions Selangor on April 5 and 19 in a two-legged showdown.

item.title: Home for the holidays: Paddlers relish longer CNY break
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The national table tennis squad, which had a busy second half of last year, will have more time to savour Chinese New Year this season.

item.title: Bangladesh PM-to-be Tarique Rahman and lawmakers sworn into parliament
item.description: DHAKA: Bangladesh’s prime minister-to-be Tarique Rahman and lawmakers were sworn into parliament on Tuesday, becoming the first elected representatives since a deadly 2024 uprising.
